verdict.rationale: LanceDB's versioning docs explicitly mention 'version control, data snapshots, and audit trails' and time-travel capabilities for reproducibility/compliance, and branching lets you fork isolated points-in-time for experiments/rebuilds, which functions as a coarse backup/restore mechanism. However, there is no dedicated 'backup' or 'restore' API/CLI, no documentation on exporting/restoring a collection to a different cluster or after data loss, and no disaster-recovery workflow described. Missing for 10: explicit backup/export command, restore-to-new-location workflow, disaster-recovery guidance, and independent confirmation of snapshot/restore reliability.
